prompts.question: Is the company entered in Zefix, the central Swiss business name index, with a UID, legal form, seat and current status?
prompts.why_it_matters: The federal index is the baseline check that the company legally exists, where it is seated and whether it is active or in liquidation.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the Zefix company search and enter the exact company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears with a UID, legal form, registered seat and a status such as active, in liquidation or cancelled.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search on the exact company name returns no register entry.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register cannot be searched, the name is too common to match, or the entry cannot be read.
